seed_count_rule.rule: a test with an arm below min_seeds seeds is not estimable and enters Holm with p = 1 (primary and sensitivity); the arm's AUCs stay in arm_points (descriptive)

sensitivity_calibrated_t.label: calibrated sensitivity test (secondary, never the verdict): t = estimate / sqrt(sum_a w_a^2 s_a^2 / k_a), s_a^2 = across-seed variance (ddof 1) of arm a's per-seed endpoint on the full test set, two-sided p from t with Welch-Satterthwaite df (df_a = k_a - 1); T3 = the same test on E2a - b7 at c40, only when T3 is estimable; Holm over the five (not estimable or degenerate -> p = 1); a degenerate test (SE = 0) reads 'degenerate (SE = 0; not evaluable)'
sensitivity_calibrated_t.multiplicity: Holm over 5 sensitivity p-values at family alpha 0.05
